'''Brad Beddlion''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Nevada State Championship]] on 15 April 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2080">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-4-15-01-nevada-statesd2080/ 4-15-01-nevada-states], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-4-15-01-nevada-statesd2080/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
